name: Nuclear War
overview: Scripture warns of devastating conflicts in the last days, describing severe judgments where enemies of God's people will suffer intense destruction, as seen in Zechariah 14:12. Jesus foretells wars and rumors of wars as signs that the end has not yet come, emphasizing the necessity of these events in God's sovereign plan (Matthew 24:6). The severity of these times is such that without divine intervention, no flesh would survive, but for the sake of the elect, God will shorten these days (Matthew 24:22). This teaches believers to trust in God's control amid tribulation and to remain steadfast in faith.
